name: Utrecht University
header:
Utrecht University
Netherlands · MSc Mathematical Sciences, AG/Number Theory and geometry tracks; subsequent employed PhD
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• UES is discontinued; NL Scholarship pays only in year one.
• All required reference forms must arrive by the application deadline; submitted forms cannot be changed.
• Foreign final-year applicants need official anticipated-degree paperwork.
• Pieropan and Commelin hold part-time Utrecht roles; Van de Leur is a guest.
• Oort and Beukers are emeritus, Van der Kallen/Bruggeman are guests, and Van den Ban emeritus; they are
not listed as ordinary available PhD advisers. Postdocs are not treated as permanent primary advisers.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Selective MSc: mathematics bachelor, or related degree with substantial mathematics, individually compared
with Utrecht preparation. UChicago BA potentially qualifies. Requires real analysis, linear algebra and
probability, plus advanced work in at least three listed areas (including complex/functional analysis,
geometry/topology, algebra/number theory, logic and others). Motivation and academic performance matter.
Direct BA-to-PhD is not established: the live mathematics PhD explicitly requires completed/nearly completed
MSc. [admit] [phd]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Register in Studielink, then complete OSIRIS documents, referee invitations and fee. Credentials may take up
to two working days. Obtain UChicago’s signed/stamped anticipated-degree statement if still studying. Apply
separately for NL Scholarship after academic application. No MSc supervisor agreement prerequisite listed.
[admit] [anticipated] [nl]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No MSc supervisor commitment listed. Cornelissen’s official-linked page invites contact about number-theory
theses. PhD jobs have their own supervisor/contact; the live Heuts call is master’s-level. Pieropan is part-time
Utrecht after moving to Düsseldorf in August 2026; Commelin is also part-time. New PhD availability for other
faculty unknown. [admit] [phd] [ag] [nt] [pieropanrole] [commelinrole] [cornelissencontact]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
OSIRIS tracks file/offer and referee status, payment and scholarship submission. Incomplete applications
prompt email and replacement uploads; academic decisions targeted within 20 working days after verification.
Post-submission changes are exceptional: email Student Services with replacement and explanation. [admit]
[after] [faq]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
2027-28 tuition and September 2027 NL Scholarship are explicit. MSc general deadline table is standing policy
without printed year. Live PhD deadline November 15, 2026 belongs to a specific master’s-required job. [tuition]
[nl] [admit] [phd]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing September-entry calendar: opens October 1; scholarship applicants February 1, non-EU passport
holders April 1, EU passport holders June 1, all 23:59 CET/CEST. The routine programme table does not
explicitly label the year; for September 2027 these are the standing calendar dates, not an independently
dated 2027 call. February-entry calendar: opens July 1; non-EU September 1, EU October 15. The live PhD
closes November 15, 2026 (hour unstated). [admit] [phd]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
NL Scholarship explicitly covers September 1, 2027 entry; apply by February 1, 2027 at 23:59 CET. Academic
application must also meet the scholarship deadline. If submitted January 27-February 1, incomplete/incorrect
scholarship information cannot be corrected or supplemented. Results targeted mid-April. UES no longer
accepts new applications. [nl] [ues]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Both OSIRIS referee forms must be submitted before the applicable academic application deadline; the
applicant can submit first but no grace period is promised. Thus use the February 1 scholarship deadline when
seeking NL Scholarship. PhD job asks at least two reference contacts; letter-contact timing and separate
deadline not stated. [admit] [refs] [phd]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English test may follow initial application: enter planned test/date in OSIRIS. For September entry, non-EU/EEA
conditional evidence is due June 15; EU/EEA September 1, subject to the individual admission letter. UChicago
completed English BA meets the published exemption. [faq] [conditions] [eng]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Initial records/narratives/fee due by application deadline. September non-EU/EEA applicants: certified
anticipated degree and latest transcript by June 15 if not yet graduated; final diploma by September 1.
Graduates supply certified diploma/transcript by June 15. EU/EEA final conditions normally September 1. The
individual conditional letter may impose course/test conditions. [admit] [conditions]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Accept the conditional offer in OSIRIS to reserve the place and trigger Visa Office contact. University
recommends prompt acceptance but does not publish a universal commitment date; individual
offer/scholarship and immigration instructions govern. [after]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
EMI-experienced: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall/6.0 each; pre-January 21, 2026 TOEFL iBT 93/20 each; later
TOEFL scale overall 4.5, speaking 4/listening 4.5/reading 4.5/writing 4. Cambridge C1 176/169 each or C2
180/169 each. IELTS/TOEFL maximum two years old. TOEFL Home accepted; IELTS Online, One Skill Retake and
TOEFL MyBest rejected. [eng]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Yes for a fully English-taught bachelor or master obtained in the United States. After conditional admission,
provide certified degree/transcript establishing the exemption. Admissions gives the binding decision during
formal assessment, not by a pre-application email. [eng] [faq]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No GRE requirement appears in the MSc checklist or live PhD vacancy. No explicit
considered/ignored/prohibited submission policy found; unsolicited-score upload permission remains unknown.
[admit] [phd]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Initial diploma or anticipated-degree evidence and transcript scans. UChicago English records need no
translation. Anticipated-degree form requires identity, degree name/duration, remaining courses, expected
graduation, and authorised official’s name/position/signature/stamp. After offer, securely verifiable digital
records, direct registrar email to admissiondocuments@uu.nl, approved verification systems (including
Parchment/NSC), or certified hard copies are accepted. [admit] [anticipated] [conditions]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Remaining courses and credits where available belong in the official anticipated-degree statement. The MSc
checklist does not name a separate complete maths-course inventory. [anticipated] [admit]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No programme-specific syllabus upload listed. General FAQ explains that programmes requesting syllabi want
official topics, learning outcomes, credits, teaching/assessment and reading. Ask the MSc coordinator whether
additional evidence is needed for course-equivalence review; no verified mathematics-specific format/limit.
[admit] [faq]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two referees; at least one academic able to discuss academic performance. No friends/family; referees must
answer follow-up questions. Exceptional professional substitutions require committee acceptance. Referee
form can be English or Dutch. [refs] [faq]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
NL Scholarship does not publicly add a third referee or scholarship-only questionnaire. Academic references
remain the two OSIRIS suitability forms; scholarship motivation and financial plan are separate. [refs] [nl]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Submitting referee contact details in OSIRIS sends an email asking the referee to accept. After accepting, the
referee completes an online suitability form, which is the recommendation; this is not described as a free-form
uploaded letter. Use one browser/tab to avoid errors. [refs]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
The instructions permit academic application submission before a referee completes the form. They describe
invitations when contact details are submitted, without requiring final academic submission first. Exact
save-versus-send UI control remains portal-specific. [refs]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
OSIRIS has reference-status tracking. “Busy” means link opened but form not submitted; it is not receipt of a
finished reference. Monitor actual completion before deadline. [faq]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Submitted reference cannot be changed. Before submission, remove an invitation with red X and
resend/replace it; up to two referees total. If institutional mail blocks invitations, FAQ permits a personal
address. No cross-programme/year reuse guarantee found. [faq]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required English CV; linked template asks for relevant internships, work, student/voluntary activity, notable
academic/extracurricular achievements and developed competencies (faithful paraphrase). PDF upload
required by template. No stated page cap/font/margin rule; supporting facts should be concise. [cv] [faq]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required English motivation statement. Faithful paraphrase of six prompts: why this programme/Utrecht;
relevant experience; preferred subject areas and reasons; evidence of required qualities; career/research
goals; reflection on academic achievements. Generally 1-2 pages, not a stated hard maximum. Linked
template or your own document may be uploaded; no font/margin rule given. [sop]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate background/personal essay named; experiences/qualities can be addressed in motivation.
Separate prompt, length and upload permission unverified. [admit] [sop]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in motivation via subject interests and career/research ambitions. No distinct MSc research-interest
statement. Live Heuts PhD motivation asks which mathematics areas interest you and your
knowledge/experience; no public length rule. [sop] [phd]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No independent MSc research proposal in checklist. The live PhD is project-based and requests motivation
rather than a separately specified proposal. Independent optional-upload rules unknown. [admit] [phd]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No thesis/writing sample in the published MSc checklist or cited PhD vacancy. No confirmed optional upload or
link-substitution instruction. [admit] [phd]
Publications list [Standing rule]
CV template explicitly permits exceptional academic achievements such as publications. No distinct
publication list, paper upload or URL requirement. [cv]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Remaining-course information appears in anticipated-degree evidence, not a separate essay. No full
maths-course-list template/length specified. [anticipated]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
NL Scholarship motivation (faithful paraphrase): explain how study in the Netherlands/Utrecht supports future
goals. Complete the financial-resources PDF covering the whole nominal programme: personal/family funds,
loans, scholarships, sponsor/other resources and expected award dates. Scholarship form’s exact extra
questions, character cap and narrative file formatting are not public. [nl] [financial]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Passport copy required. If unavoidable missing documents prevent completion, FAQ allows a PDF explanation
as last resort and advises contacting Student Services; this is not automatic waiver of completeness. [admit]
[faq]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No automatic MSc stipend. NL Scholarship offers €5,000/€10,000/€15,000 only in the first year, including for
two-year programmes; remaining costs must be funded. Current mathematics PhD example pays €3,204
gross/month in year 1 up to €4,051 in year 4 at 38 hours, plus 8% holiday and 8.3% year-end bonus, pension
benefits and research travel support; not a guaranteed 2027 offer. [nl] [phd]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc normally two years; NL Scholarship payment is first-year only. Heuts PhD advertised four years, initially 18
months then extension after positive assessment. [nl] [phd]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
NL Scholarship: non-EU/EEA passport, ineligible for Dutch study finance/statutory tuition, no earlier Dutch

institutional enrolment except exchange, eligible September 2027 programme. Mathematics expressly lists it.
F-1 status alone does not establish these conditions. [nl] [tuition]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
NL Scholarship evaluates academics, motivation and a feasible plan financing the full programme. It does not
cover all costs. Current PhD appointment includes undergraduate teaching and continuation assessment. [nl]
[phd]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
NL Scholarship requires an OSIRIS scholarship form after the academic application; locate the linked award
under the dashboard, complete questions and submit separately. No extra recommendation specified. [nl]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Utrecht Excellence Scholarship discontinued for new starts from 2026-27. Programme lists
nationality-dependent sources such as Canadian loans, Fulbright/NAF and Erasmus+ loans, but UChicago study
does not confer US-citizen award eligibility. Later PhD funding comes through a live employment offer, not the
MSc admission. [ues] [tuition] [phd]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
€100 nonrefundable application fee, paid in OSIRIS after uploads by Visa/Mastercard/Amex; valid for three
years and covers multiple programme applications. 2027-28 tuition €26,100/year non-EU/EEA; €2,771
statutory-eligible full-time students. Individual nationality/residence exceptions apply. [fee] [tuition]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published exemptions: Dutch-degree applicants, present/past Utrecht exchange students, recognised refugees
in Netherlands, and specified privately funded programmes (not mathematics). Request exemption actively in
OSIRIS and allow two business days. No UChicago/F-1 waiver established. [fee]

sections.title: Conflicts and remaining checks
sections.text:
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Programme says OSIRIS credentials within two working days; general FAQ says within 24 hours - allow two
working days. Some staff publication tabs lag institutional research portals by several years; recent
publications and current personal-site appointments were cross-checked. UES availability claims in older
guides are superseded by discontinuation notice. [admit] [faq] [ues]
Checks still needed [Standing rule]
Confirm passport category, precise programme offer deadline, NL Scholarship portal prompt limits, and
exemption processing while UChicago degree is unfinished. GRE submission policy and reference reuse across
applications not public. Any independent course-description/sample upload must be confirmed. For later PhD,
identify a current funded job and master’s-equivalence route. [admit] [nl] [refs] [phd]

text:
Utrecht University
Netherlands · MSc Mathematical Sciences, AG/Number Theory and geometry tracks; subsequent employed PhD
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• UES is discontinued; NL Scholarship pays only in year one.
• All required reference forms must arrive by the application deadline; submitted forms cannot be changed.
• Foreign final-year applicants need official anticipated-degree paperwork.
• Pieropan and Commelin hold part-time Utrecht roles; Van de Leur is a guest.
• Oort and Beukers are emeritus, Van der Kallen/Bruggeman are guests, and Van den Ban emeritus; they are
not listed as ordinary available PhD advisers. Postdocs are not treated as permanent primary advisers.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Selective MSc: mathematics bachelor, or related degree with substantial mathematics, individually compared
with Utrecht preparation. UChicago BA potentially qualifies. Requires real analysis, linear algebra and
probability, plus advanced work in at least three listed areas (including complex/functional analysis,
geometry/topology, algebra/number theory, logic and others). Motivation and academic performance matter.
Direct BA-to-PhD is not established: the live mathematics PhD explicitly requires completed/nearly completed
MSc. [admit] [phd]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Register in Studielink, then complete OSIRIS documents, referee invitations and fee. Credentials may take up
to two working days. Obtain UChicago’s signed/stamped anticipated-degree statement if still studying. Apply
separately for NL Scholarship after academic application. No MSc supervisor agreement prerequisite listed.
[admit] [anticipated] [nl]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No MSc supervisor commitment listed. Cornelissen’s official-linked page invites contact about number-theory
theses. PhD jobs have their own supervisor/contact; the live Heuts call is master’s-level. Pieropan is part-time
Utrecht after moving to Düsseldorf in August 2026; Commelin is also part-time. New PhD availability for other
faculty unknown. [admit] [phd] [ag] [nt] [pieropanrole] [commelinrole] [cornelissencontact]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
OSIRIS tracks file/offer and referee status, payment and scholarship submission. Incomplete applications
prompt email and replacement uploads; academic decisions targeted within 20 working days after verification.
Post-submission changes are exceptional: email Student Services with replacement and explanation. [admit]
[after] [faq]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
2027-28 tuition and September 2027 NL Scholarship are explicit. MSc general deadline table is standing policy
without printed year. Live PhD deadline November 15, 2026 belongs to a specific master’s-required job. [tuition]
[nl] [admit] [phd]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing September-entry calendar: opens October 1; scholarship applicants February 1, non-EU passport
holders April 1, EU passport holders June 1, all 23:59 CET/CEST. The routine programme table does not
explicitly label the year; for September 2027 these are the standing calendar dates, not an independently
dated 2027 call. February-entry calendar: opens July 1; non-EU September 1, EU October 15. The live PhD
closes November 15, 2026 (hour unstated). [admit] [phd]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
NL Scholarship explicitly covers September 1, 2027 entry; apply by February 1, 2027 at 23:59 CET. Academic
application must also meet the scholarship deadline. If submitted January 27-February 1, incomplete/incorrect
scholarship information cannot be corrected or supplemented. Results targeted mid-April. UES no longer
accepts new applications. [nl] [ues]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Both OSIRIS referee forms must be submitted before the applicable academic application deadline; the
applicant can submit first but no grace period is promised. Thus use the February 1 scholarship deadline when
seeking NL Scholarship. PhD job asks at least two reference contacts; letter-contact timing and separate
deadline not stated. [admit] [refs] [phd]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English test may follow initial application: enter planned test/date in OSIRIS. For September entry, non-EU/EEA
conditional evidence is due June 15; EU/EEA September 1, subject to the individual admission letter. UChicago
completed English BA meets the published exemption. [faq] [conditions] [eng]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Initial records/narratives/fee due by application deadline. September non-EU/EEA applicants: certified
anticipated degree and latest transcript by June 15 if not yet graduated; final diploma by September 1.
Graduates supply certified diploma/transcript by June 15. EU/EEA final conditions normally September 1. The
individual conditional letter may impose course/test conditions. [admit] [conditions]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Accept the conditional offer in OSIRIS to reserve the place and trigger Visa Office contact. University
recommends prompt acceptance but does not publish a universal commitment date; individual
offer/scholarship and immigration instructions govern. [after]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
EMI-experienced: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall/6.0 each; pre-January 21, 2026 TOEFL iBT 93/20 each; later
TOEFL scale overall 4.5, speaking 4/listening 4.5/reading 4.5/writing 4. Cambridge C1 176/169 each or C2
180/169 each. IELTS/TOEFL maximum two years old. TOEFL Home accepted; IELTS Online, One Skill Retake and
TOEFL MyBest rejected. [eng]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Yes for a fully English-taught bachelor or master obtained in the United States. After conditional admission,
provide certified degree/transcript establishing the exemption. Admissions gives the binding decision during
formal assessment, not by a pre-application email. [eng] [faq]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No GRE requirement appears in the MSc checklist or live PhD vacancy. No explicit
considered/ignored/prohibited submission policy found; unsolicited-score upload permission remains unknown.
[admit] [phd]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Initial diploma or anticipated-degree evidence and transcript scans. UChicago English records need no
translation. Anticipated-degree form requires identity, degree name/duration, remaining courses, expected
graduation, and authorised official’s name/position/signature/stamp. After offer, securely verifiable digital
records, direct registrar email to admissiondocuments@uu.nl, approved verification systems (including
Parchment/NSC), or certified hard copies are accepted. [admit] [anticipated] [conditions]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Remaining courses and credits where available belong in the official anticipated-degree statement. The MSc
checklist does not name a separate complete maths-course inventory. [anticipated] [admit]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No programme-specific syllabus upload listed. General FAQ explains that programmes requesting syllabi want
official topics, learning outcomes, credits, teaching/assessment and reading. Ask the MSc coordinator whether
additional evidence is needed for course-equivalence review; no verified mathematics-specific format/limit.
[admit] [faq]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two referees; at least one academic able to discuss academic performance. No friends/family; referees must
answer follow-up questions. Exceptional professional substitutions require committee acceptance. Referee
form can be English or Dutch. [refs] [faq]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
NL Scholarship does not publicly add a third referee or scholarship-only questionnaire. Academic references
remain the two OSIRIS suitability forms; scholarship motivation and financial plan are separate. [refs] [nl]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Submitting referee contact details in OSIRIS sends an email asking the referee to accept. After accepting, the
referee completes an online suitability form, which is the recommendation; this is not described as a free-form
uploaded letter. Use one browser/tab to avoid errors. [refs]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
The instructions permit academic application submission before a referee completes the form. They describe
invitations when contact details are submitted, without requiring final academic submission first. Exact
save-versus-send UI control remains portal-specific. [refs]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
OSIRIS has reference-status tracking. “Busy” means link opened but form not submitted; it is not receipt of a
finished reference. Monitor actual completion before deadline. [faq]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Submitted reference cannot be changed. Before submission, remove an invitation with red X and
resend/replace it; up to two referees total. If institutional mail blocks invitations, FAQ permits a personal
address. No cross-programme/year reuse guarantee found. [faq]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required English CV; linked template asks for relevant internships, work, student/voluntary activity, notable
academic/extracurricular achievements and developed competencies (faithful paraphrase). PDF upload
required by template. No stated page cap/font/margin rule; supporting facts should be concise. [cv] [faq]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required English motivation statement. Faithful paraphrase of six prompts: why this programme/Utrecht;
relevant experience; preferred subject areas and reasons; evidence of required qualities; career/research
goals; reflection on academic achievements. Generally 1-2 pages, not a stated hard maximum. Linked
template or your own document may be uploaded; no font/margin rule given. [sop]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate background/personal essay named; experiences/qualities can be addressed in motivation.
Separate prompt, length and upload permission unverified. [admit] [sop]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in motivation via subject interests and career/research ambitions. No distinct MSc research-interest
statement. Live Heuts PhD motivation asks which mathematics areas interest you and your
knowledge/experience; no public length rule. [sop] [phd]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No independent MSc research proposal in checklist. The live PhD is project-based and requests motivation
rather than a separately specified proposal. Independent optional-upload rules unknown. [admit] [phd]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No thesis/writing sample in the published MSc checklist or cited PhD vacancy. No confirmed optional upload or
link-substitution instruction. [admit] [phd]
Publications list [Standing rule]
CV template explicitly permits exceptional academic achievements such as publications. No distinct
publication list, paper upload or URL requirement. [cv]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Remaining-course information appears in anticipated-degree evidence, not a separate essay. No full
maths-course-list template/length specified. [anticipated]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
NL Scholarship motivation (faithful paraphrase): explain how study in the Netherlands/Utrecht supports future
goals. Complete the financial-resources PDF covering the whole nominal programme: personal/family funds,
loans, scholarships, sponsor/other resources and expected award dates. Scholarship form’s exact extra
questions, character cap and narrative file formatting are not public. [nl] [financial]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Passport copy required. If unavoidable missing documents prevent completion, FAQ allows a PDF explanation
as last resort and advises contacting Student Services; this is not automatic waiver of completeness. [admit]
[faq]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No automatic MSc stipend. NL Scholarship offers €5,000/€10,000/€15,000 only in the first year, including for
two-year programmes; remaining costs must be funded. Current mathematics PhD example pays €3,204
gross/month in year 1 up to €4,051 in year 4 at 38 hours, plus 8% holiday and 8.3% year-end bonus, pension
benefits and research travel support; not a guaranteed 2027 offer. [nl] [phd]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc normally two years; NL Scholarship payment is first-year only. Heuts PhD advertised four years, initially 18
months then extension after positive assessment. [nl] [phd]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
NL Scholarship: non-EU/EEA passport, ineligible for Dutch study finance/statutory tuition, no earlier Dutch

institutional enrolment except exchange, eligible September 2027 programme. Mathematics expressly lists it.
F-1 status alone does not establish these conditions. [nl] [tuition]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
NL Scholarship evaluates academics, motivation and a feasible plan financing the full programme. It does not
cover all costs. Current PhD appointment includes undergraduate teaching and continuation assessment. [nl]
[phd]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
NL Scholarship requires an OSIRIS scholarship form after the academic application; locate the linked award
under the dashboard, complete questions and submit separately. No extra recommendation specified. [nl]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Utrecht Excellence Scholarship discontinued for new starts from 2026-27. Programme lists
nationality-dependent sources such as Canadian loans, Fulbright/NAF and Erasmus+ loans, but UChicago study
does not confer US-citizen award eligibility. Later PhD funding comes through a live employment offer, not the
MSc admission. [ues] [tuition] [phd]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
€100 nonrefundable application fee, paid in OSIRIS after uploads by Visa/Mastercard/Amex; valid for three
years and covers multiple programme applications. 2027-28 tuition €26,100/year non-EU/EEA; €2,771
statutory-eligible full-time students. Individual nationality/residence exceptions apply. [fee] [tuition]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published exemptions: Dutch-degree applicants, present/past Utrecht exchange students, recognised refugees
in Netherlands, and specified privately funded programmes (not mathematics). Request exemption actively in
OSIRIS and allow two business days. No UChicago/F-1 waiver established. [fee]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Programme says OSIRIS credentials within two working days; general FAQ says within 24 hours - allow two
working days. Some staff publication tabs lag institutional research portals by several years; recent
publications and current personal-site appointments were cross-checked. UES availability claims in older
guides are superseded by discontinuation notice. [admit] [faq] [ues]
Checks still needed [Standing rule]
Confirm passport category, precise programme offer deadline, NL Scholarship portal prompt limits, and
